listenings.text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Meteoro meeting. My name is Daniel Fischer. I work at a university in Canada. I teach education, and I manage the research group. Today we talk about technology in public schools. Every person in this room works with schools, in four different countries. Please say your name and your country before you speak. Thank you very much.

Hello, this is a short message about the new platform. The platform is for public schools. It is very simple. A teacher opens the platform, and she sees her class. She reads the lesson, and she shares it with the students. A director opens the platform too, and he sees all the classes in the school. Our team evaluates the platform every month. If you have a question, please write to us. Thank you.

paras: The Meteoro Program connects public schools in Brazil, Canada, Germany and the United States. The team works with teachers and with new technology.
Joice Lopes Leite works in São Paulo. She evaluates educational platforms for the State of São Paulo, and she works with public schools every week.
Daniel Fischer works at a university in Canada. He teaches education, and he manages the research group. He speaks English and German.
Ana Costa is a researcher in Salvador. She researches technology in public schools, and she writes the reports for the team.
